nearest_flip.note: Composite already RED. E5 red (Risk Matrix DEFLATION only) or E6 red → 53.3. Reverts to 49.2 AMBER only if the OpenAI first close is denied/corrected or shown ≥$15B; E4 recovering alone → 50.0, still RED.

A.title: Capex intent & spend
A.read: Big-4 capex/OCF near 115% remains the weak spot; TSMC October revenue was a record +59.7% YoY and Taiwan server ODMs roughly doubled (Confirmed/Reported).

B.title: Financing & credit
B.read: RED driver. Huang's exit puts NVIDIA's backstops in question: SemiAnalysis cites $530B of off-balance-sheet guarantees and $36B take-or-pay floors under neoclouds (Reported). NVIDIA's $10B slice of Anthropic's $26B placement is now the IPO's open question ahead of Nov 18 pricing; no S-1/A-3 (Reported). ORCL 5y CDS ~300bp; OpenAI round still under the ~$15B gate.

C.title: Demand & unit economics
C.read: GPU rents firm: H100 20-session $3.18, B200 $9.63 through Nov 9 (Ornn, Reported). No demand-caused cancellations.

D.title: Physical constraints
D.read: Permit and grid constraints remain red (Texas governor-elect pause language is intent, not policy). No demand-cited signed-capacity cancellation; T-16 Watch hit only.

E.title: Macro & markets
E.read: E4 stays red (SOX −3.4% vs 200d Nov 12). 10y 5.10% Nov 12, ~5.13% pre-PPI; October PPI headline +0.3% (a touch soft), core in line. 42 Macro: INFLATION, risk-off 67% (Nov 12 Leadoff); KISS 95/0/0/5. E6 amber.

pattern: Financing breaks first. The lab-funding and neocloud-credit legs have now pushed the composite into RED while GPU rents, contract prices and supplier commitments are still firm — a funding-before-orders sequence, not yet a physical-demand bust.
decisive: Financing window shut for good — lab/neocloud IPO pulled or GPU-backed loan default (T-15)
Hyperscaler cancelling capacity for demand reasons rather than grid (D2b), or Big-4 capex outrunning OCF while 2027 guides decelerate (T-16)
